name: douyu-live-hub
description: 基于斗鱼公开数据的第三方跨平台直播聚合应用

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron/builder.conf.json --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron/builder.conf.json --publish never
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron/builder.conf.json --publish never
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron/builder.conf.json --publish never
